newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks open easier, media group Havas jumps.
newsitem.headline: French stocks open easier, media group Havas jumps.

text.p: French shares opened easier on profit-taking and in reaction to a Friday slide in Wall Street but Havas made an opening jump of over eight percent on news it was in talks over its Canal Plus stake.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 5.98 points or 0.24 percent at 2,510.58 at 0912 GMT while the CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,515 from 2,517 on Friday's close.
The index had posted an all-time high on Friday.
* Generale des Eaux slipped 0.85 percent to 702 francs.
* Alcatel Alsthom was 0.73 percent lower at 544 francs. Alcatel confirmed it was in talks with Aerospatiale and Dassault Aviation about a possible joint bid for the state's stake in Thomson-CSF.
A company source said it was also in talks with Generale des Eaux about selling part of its stake in Havas.
* A block of 1.23 billion shares in insurance giant Axa-UAP was traded at 366 francs at 0914 GMT. It was up 0.68 percent at 367.50.
